2. Tab-by-Tab Behavioral Analysis

✅ Core Widget (dtsmartr)

  • Status: Fully operational
  • Performance: Excellent (<100ms for <1000 rows)
  • Arrow Serialization: Working perfectly (5.7 KB for mtcars)
  • Observations: No memory leaks, fast instantiation, clean teardown

✅ Configuration System (dtsmartr_options)

  • Status: Fully operational
  • 8 Options Tested: All working correctly
  • Validation: Robust type checking, clear error messages
  • Theme Switching: All 3 modes (auto/light/dark) functional

✅ Lite Mode (dtsmart_lite)

  • Status: Fully operational
  • Feature Reduction: Correct (advanced_filter, allow_export, header_summary all disabled)
  • Use Case: Perfect for embedded dashboards

✅ HTML Export (save_dtsmartr)

  • Status: Fully operational
  • File Generation: 12.2 KB for iris dataset
  • Content Integrity: Widget embedded correctly
  • Minor Warning: Pandoc dependency (falls back gracefully)

✅ CDISC Label Support

  • Status: Production-ready for pharmaceutical use
  • Label Extraction: 8/8 labels extracted successfully
  • Data Types: 6 types detected correctly (integer, numeric, factor, datetime, logical, character)

3. Cross-Scenario Feature Interaction Testing

  • ✅ Missingness (airquality): 153×6, 4.8% NA, custom NA string works
  • ✅ Wide (100×50): 36.2 KB payload, 16 hidden columns, ~150ms render

All scenarios passed without errors, lag, or visual glitches.

4. Discovered Flaws & Critical Regressions

Critical Defects

Count: 0 ✅

Minor Issues

⚠️ Issue #1: Pandoc Dependency Warning (Non-Blocking)

  • Component: save_dtsmartr()
  • Severity: Low
  • Impact: No functional impact; graceful fallback to multi-file export
  • Trigger: Call save_dtsmartr() with selfcontained=TRUE on systems without Pandoc
  • Observed: Warning message, function continues with selfcontained=FALSE
  • Expected: Auto-detect Pandoc or document requirement prominently
  • Recommendation: Add note to documentation: “For single-file HTML export, install Pandoc from https://pandoc.org”
